leaves.doc: Friedberg-Hoffstein, Ann. of Math. (2) 142 (1995) 385-423, Theorem B, printed form (F = Q, pi = pi_f, f a weight-2 newform of trivial nebentypus; chi_0 = chi_D0 unramified at the finite places of S): local conditions as equality of the norm-residue local characters, chi_d from its local components, root number as the sign of the functional equation (some conductor), infinitely many as Set.Infinite; locator UNVERIFIED
leaves.flag: unread: Friedberg-Hoffstein 1995 Thm B label, page and hypotheses recalled from memory (locator UNVERIFIED); one reading left: L(s, pi_f x chi_d) is taken as the classical series sum a_n(f) chi_d(n) n^(-s-1/2) for chi_d unramified at the primes dividing N (local newform theory), since Mathlib has no automorphic L-functions; equivalent in Lean to the previous leaf FriedbergHoffsteinB_FE (friedbergHoffsteinB_printed_iff_FE)
leaves.source: Friedberg-Hoffstein, Ann. of Math. 142 (1995), Thm B, printed form over norm-residue local characters, the idelic character of Q(sqrt d) and the sign of the functional equation (fh-printed; locator UNVERIFIED)
